//: Copy to ~/.claude/vstack.config.json and edit. Every key is optional; a skill that finds no config uses the documented default and says so. Nothing company-specific belongs in a VStack skill file — it belongs here.

memoryBank.//: A corpus to read before designing. Skills read from `ref`, never by switching the checkout's branch.

paths.//: worktrees is relative to each repo and should be gitignored there. taskWork is outside every repo, deliberately.

repos.//: Per-repo overrides. Omit a repo to auto-detect its default branch.

ci.//: Checks that always fail everywhere and mean nothing. Naming one here is a claim you have verified it, not a way to silence a real failure.

deploy.//: enabled:false means deploy-rc refuses to run at all. releaseBranch 'derive' reads the base of recently merged deploy PRs instead of assuming the default branch.

goals.//: Name of a local skill that owns writing goals to wherever they live — a wiki, a tracker, a page. weekly-goals hands off to it and never invents a destination.

browser.//: driver is for real browsing in your own session. testDriver wants a cold deterministic profile and is used for UI proof.
